audit_items.proof_trace: Promise.all(members.map(...guild.members.fetch...)) fires one concurrent Discord API call per DB member with no concurrency cap, no chunking, and no MAX_CONCURRENT constant anywhere in the codebase. The Supabase query has no LIMIT clause, so member count is unbounded. The property's guard simply does not exist.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated client calls GET /api/members repeatedly; each request fires N simultaneous guild.members.fetch calls (N = all non-deleted members). With 100+ members this exhausts Discord's per-bot rate limit window (HTTP 429), causing all member lookups to fail until the window resets.
